title: Can ten dots be a triangle and a rectangle?
description: Ten dots are first stacked in rows of one, two, three and four to make a triangle, then laid in two rows of five to make a rectangle. Keeko's doubt, that a number can be drawn in only one way, is broken.
teaching_notes: One idea: the same number of dots can be arranged in more than one shape. Watch for students who think a number has only one picture.

source: Show 10 dots as a triangle and as a rectangle.
video_script.why: The child arranges the same ten dots in two different shapes and sees that one number can have more than one picture.
video_script.substitution: The same dots can be rearranged into rows of a different kind, and then they make a different shape.
video_script.anchor: ten dots in a loose pile, with two empty outlines beside them, one for a triangle and one for a rectangle
video_script.wrong_answer: a number can be drawn in only one way
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko says a number can be drawn in only one way, so ten dots cannot be both shapes. The same ten dots stack as a triangle and also lie in two rows of five as a rectangle, and the doubt is struck.
video_script.payoff_line: The same ten dots make a triangle and a rectangle

final_answer.value: The same 10 dots make a triangle and a rectangle.
final_answer.spoken: the same ten dots make a triangle and a rectangle

hold_back: The same 10 dots make a triangle and a rectangle
never_show: a number can be drawn in only one way
maths_rules: triangle: rows of 1, 2, 3 and 4 dots, since 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 10
rectangle: 2 rows of 5 dots, since 2 x 5 = 10
the same 10 dots are used in both shapes
slip: one number can have more than one picture
video_script.design: One idea: the same dots can make two shapes. Assumes triangular dot pictures. Wrong idea: a number has one picture only. The ten dots stay on the board to the end.

narration: <bookmark mark='rows'/>Loose dots can be moved into rows. If each row is one dot longer than the row above, the rows make a triangle.
<bookmark mark='equal'/>If every row has the same number of dots, the rows make a rectangle.
